author: Evan Edinger
description:
Who really controls London's streets? 
Register to vote by April 20th! https://www.gov.uk/register-to-vote
Find out who you can vote for in the council elections May 7th! https://whocanivotefor.co.uk
Ted Maxwell is running for councillor: https://ted4bgw.vote

I reached out to the Mayor of Tower Hamlets for comment, but they directed me to the mayor's tweet about the appeal which is within this video. 

Vlog channel https://youtube.com/EvanEdinger

Thank you so much for watching! Hope you enjoyed it!


If you're new to my channel and videos, hi! I'm Evan Edinger, and I make weekly "comedy" videos every Sunday evening. As an American living in London I love noticing the funny differences between the cultures and one of my most popular video series is my British VS American one. I'm also known for making terrible puns so sorry in advance. Hope to see you around, and I'll see you next Sunday! :)
